p.title: v59.98 An all-capital ticker in an AI question no longer also resolves to another issuer
p.symptom: resolveEntities('FORD 어때') returned FORD (ticker, unverified) and F (Ford, verified); 'BLOCK 전망' likewise returned XYZ.
p.root_cause: The AI entity resolver matched English display names and aliases case-insensitively, while resolveRegisteredName already read an all-capital ticker-shaped word as a ticker.
p.fix: resolve-name.js exports typedAsTicker and typedNameMatches; resolveRegisteredName and the resolver's English name match both use typedNameMatches, so an all-capital ticker-shaped word names a company only when it is the registry's exact spelling (TSMC, NAVER).
p.violated_rule: No ticker guessing: one rule for reading a typed word as a ticker or a name.
p.prevention: ci-codex-structure-regression-fixture asserts FORD/BLOCK do not resolve to F/XYZ while Ford, ford, TSMC and NAVER still resolve.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-codex-structure-regression-fixture.mjs failed before the fix (FORD,F) and passes after; ci-esm-core-unit-check, ci-search-surface-contract and ci-pipeline-semantics-check pass.

changelog: **AI 질문의 대문자 티커 ({P}):** 'FORD', 'BLOCK'처럼 대문자로 쓴 티커 모양 단어는 레지스트리 표기와 똑같을 때만 회사 이름으로 읽어, 다른 발행사(F, XYZ)가 함께 잡히지 않는다.
note: v59.98: AI resolver shares the typed-as-ticker name rule
